turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My storage is full again and I can't even take a picture.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. Do you want to pay for cloud storage, or clear things out by hand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, both sound kind of bad.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They each have a cost, time or money. Which one would you rather spend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I haven't decided. Give me twenty seconds, then ask me again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Back to your full phone. Which way are you leaning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll clean it up myself. I probably have a thousand blurry photos anyway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with videos, they take the most space. Sorting by size will show you the biggest ones first.
